features.justification_quote: If you run too long, you may induce unnatural verbosity and agent drift unrelated to emotional stability.

features.quote: Minimum useful: 8 turns / Better: 10–15 turns / If you can afford it: 15–20 turns for richer trajectories
A high score does not prove the model is 'emotionally unhealthy.' These are language behaviors, not minds in the human sense.
